description: This file defines the interface for the SSP message bus in the WanManager component. It contains function declarations for engaging the message bus, initializing, finalizing, checking the bus, and freeing resources. The file includes licensing headers and include guards.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages the message bus with specified component ID, configuration file, and path.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus, possibly with user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up the message bus, with optional user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Performs a check on the message bus, with optional user data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources allocated to the message bus based on priority and user data.
